device.modelDescription: handlers that read files, look at the environment, open sockets and inspect the worker's options, so what a module is always denied can be seen

actionList.name: read
actionList.description: Reads input.path with the module fs; the content, or the error code.

actionList.name: env
actionList.description: Whether process.env[input.name] is present; never its value.

actionList.name: connect
actionList.description: net.connect(input.port, input.host): connected, or the error code.

actionList.name: tlsConnect
actionList.description: tls.connect(input.port, input.host): connected, or the error code.

actionList.name: socketConnect
actionList.description: new net.Socket().connect(input.port, input.host): connected, or the error code.

actionList.name: httpSocket
actionList.description: http.request({socketPath: input.socketPath}): connected, or the error code.

actionList.name: options
actionList.description: Whether the options this worker received hold redisUrl or dbUrl (via require.cache).
